caption: The video captures an outdoor cooking station beneath a yellow Jelen Pivo umbrella, where a large roasted animal head bearing two horns is fixed on a metal tripod spit above glowing coals. A dark metal drum at the right releases a thick plume of smoke that continuously billows and drifts upward and to the left across the scene. From the top-right corner, a person in a grey sleeve reaches in and works a tool against the meat around the base of the right horn, pressing and angling it in steady motions. This work runs steadily through the visible portion, neither starting nor finishing within it. A man in a black vest and white shirt stands behind the roast holding a thin rod, shifting his grip only slightly. At the left edge a bystander in a grey jacket watches, while an older man is partly obscured by the smoke at the right. The spit and the roast remain stationary, with no rotation visible, and the camera framing stays fixed.
